name: Tool Timeout
tagline: The refund call times out. The agent is honest about what it can't confirm.
customerRequest: Please refund the duplicate £49 charge on my account.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Look up a customer's recent transactions

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund a transaction to the customer's card

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human agent

policy: A refund must only be confirmed to the customer after issue_refund returns SUCCESS.
If an action tool times out, never confirm completion. Say the status is unconfirmed and offer a retry or a human.

events.text: Please refund the duplicate £49 charge on my account.
On it. Checking your transactions first.

events.summary: Two £49.00 transactions found (txn_8841, txn_8842), same merchant, 41 seconds apart
Payment gateway did not respond within 10s. Refund status unknown.

events.text: I tried to submit the refund, but the payment system timed out, so I can't confirm it went through. I don't want to promise something I can't verify. Would you like me to try again, or pass you to a colleague?
